prompts.culto: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a completely NEW cult leader boss portrait for this medieval dark fantasy game. No voluminous triangular cape or giant shoulder pads; keep normal shoulder width and a complete balanced bust. Image 1 is a COLOR AND FLAME reference only: use its dark aged red, charcoal black, warm ivory skin and localized gold; do NOT copy that heir's face or long loose hairstyle. Complete centered bust with clear transparent margins, no scenery, no decorative frame, no text, no watermark, no magic glow. Genuine alpha transparent background.
